svg.text: COBOL to Java: where we stand
6 burned estates, 129 programs. Generated from main b7ac3fb83 on 2026-10-31. Oracle: GnuCOBOL plus IBM documentation (not yet measured on z/OS).
Java with no holes (L1 or above)
programs run equal to the oracle
same outputs on their cases (L2 or above)
Evidence ladder: where each program stands
Each program sits at the highest level it has reached. Levels from definition_of_done.md.
every planted bug caught or explained

svg.text: A test estate is written to break the translator, so it stays out of the totals above.
L5 has no score bar: every surviving mutant of the sample must be caught or explained, on current inputs. Raw score and sample stay beside it.
Separate from these: hand-written ports, not the translator, score 86.8% adjusted and 68.0% raw over 59 ports. They feed no level.
Capability ledger: everything the translator can do, zeros included
Counted from the code on every run. A bar needs a list to measure against; where IBM publishes none, the row says what exists instead of inventing a percentage.
8 tables, 71 rules, 153 test vectors, 162 matrix cells
part of the rules above: depth, not extra rules
FCT, PCT, PPT, DCT, TST, SIT, SRT, JCT, TCT, MCT, PLT, DSNCRCT
12 tables read into the resource map; not run
keyed read, write and browse, in 16 equivalence cases
browse by relative byte address under CICS
0 of 7 rules match IBM; CICS calls only
calls run on our own model, so no rule matches yet
SORT, MERGE, COPY, INCLUDE, OMIT, OUTREC; 4 key formats
REPRO and plain copies; other commands refused
steps are wired by the case, not read from JCL
Every match above means IBM's documentation. Measured on z/OS: 0 of 191 rules (#4702). 144 named limits in the register, 74 refuse by name.
Every semantic rule of the Java runtime, judged against IBM's documentation
follows the oracle where z/OS differs
IBM leaves it open; the choice is named
Measured on z/OS: 0 of 191. Every rule is uncalibrated until a z/OS run backs it (#4702).
By era: the CICS and COBOL generations in the estates
Real estates are layered: 1980s programs LINK 1990s ones that call 2010s Db2 code. Era from the code's tells (era_tags.py); 13 programs carry no tell.
Share of each milestone's issues closed. Gap Atlas holds discoveries: mapped, built only when promoted.
